_about: Every approved battle effect and the proof that the game plays it by default (issue: battle effects audit, Nov 21 2026). approved_effects_check.gd reads this file. A new effect ruling adds a row here in the same PR as its FINDINGS row. 'unwired' lists rules events whose fx call (fx/API.md section 11) battle.gd does not make yet, each with the job that wires it; the check fails on any other unwired call, and on a listed one that is wired now (delete its row). 'covered' links looks proven by their own registered check. 'waiting' is printed only: approved looks that sit on an open pull request; when that PR merges, move the row to 'defaults' or 'covered' in the same step.
